<!--
processing_public.rmd
=====================
Public-facing data-processing pipeline. Identical to processing.rmd except
that it omits the participant-bonus calculation chunks. Reads
data/data_raw.csv and writes the anonymized data_clean_*.csv files used by analyses.rmd.
-->

```{r}
if(!suppressWarnings(require(pacman))){install.packages("pacman");library("pacman")}
p_load(tidyverse, tidyr, dplyr, ggplot2, stats, sjPlot, readr, ggpubr, patchwork, lubridate, ggthemr, ggdist, ggpubr, showtext, usethis, data.table, png, grid, purrr, ggimage, osfr, jsonlite)
```

```{r}
data_raw <- read_csv("../../data/data_raw.csv")
```

```{r}
# Anonymization: deterministic Prolific ID -> P0001, P0002, ... map.
# Applied to the prolific_pid column of every clean CSV before it is written
# to disk so that no raw Prolific IDs end up in the version-controlled data.
# data_raw and data_raw.csv stay local (see .gitignore).
anon_map <- data_raw |>
  distinct(prolific_pid) |>
  arrange(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(anon_id = sprintf("P%04d", row_number())) |>
  tibble::deframe()

anonymize_pid <- function(df) {
  df |> mutate(prolific_pid = unname(anon_map[prolific_pid]))
}
```

```{r}
comp_attempts <- data_raw |>
  filter(trial_type == "survey-multi-choice") |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  summarise(
    comp_attempts = n(),
    comp_passed = any(correct %in% TRUE),
    comp_tries_to_pass = {
      idx <- which(correct %in% TRUE)
      if (length(idx) == 0) NA_integer_ else min(idx)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
safe_fromJSON <- function(x) {
  tryCatch(fromJSON(x), error = function(e) NULL)
}

demographics <- data_raw |>
  filter(trial_type == "survey-html-form") |>
  transmute(
    prolific_pid,
    resp = map(response, safe_fromJSON)
  ) |>
  filter(map_lgl(resp, ~ !is.null(.x) && (("age" %in% names(.x)) || ("gamble_freq_12mo" %in% names(.x)) || ("hot_reliance" %in% names(.x))))) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>  
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    prolific_pid,
    feedback         = map_chr(resp, ~ .x$feedback %||% NA_character_),
    age              = map_int(resp, ~ as.integer(.x$age %||% NA_integer_)),
    gamble_freq_12mo  = map_chr(resp, ~ .x$gamble_freq_12mo %||% NA_character_),
    hot_reliance      = map_chr(resp, ~ .x$hot_reliance %||% NA_character_) |> as.integer(),
    race             = map_chr(resp, ~ .x$race %||% NA_character_),
    gender           = map_chr(resp, ~ .x$gender %||% NA_character_),
    ethnicity         = map_chr(resp, ~ .x$ethnicity %||% NA_character_)
  )
```

# Roulette

## Study 1b

### Processing

```{r}
data_clean_study1b <- data_raw |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(max_trial = max(trial_index)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(max_trial >= 50) |>
  filter(trial_type != "instructions" & trial_type != "survey-multi-choice") |>
  select(prolific_pid, balance, choice, outcome, response, banner, win_status, hot_set_size, hot_numbers, outcome_rel_to_hot, trial_type, rt) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(response = lead(response, 2)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!(is.na(balance) & is.na(hot_numbers))) |>
  filter(!(is.na(balance))) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(trial = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(choice_hot = map2_lgl(choice, hot_numbers, ~ {
    hot_nums <- fromJSON(.y)
    .x %in% hot_nums
  })) %>%
  mutate(choice_hot = case_when(choice_hot == TRUE ~ "Chose Hot", TRUE ~ "Chose Non-Hot")) |>
  select(-c(trial_type, rt, hot_numbers)) %>% 
  mutate(
    response_parsed = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    regret_chosen = map_dbl(response_parsed, ~ .x$regret_chosen %||% NA_real_),
    regret_notchosen_winner = map_dbl(response_parsed, ~ .x$regret_not_winner %||% NA_real_),
    regret_notchosen_hot_loser = map_dbl(response_parsed, ~ .x$regret_not_hot_probe %||% NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-c(response, response_parsed)) |>
  rename(
    winner_number = outcome,
    chosen_number = choice,
    banner_yn = banner
  ) |>
  relocate(trial, .after = prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(
    win_status = ifelse(win_status == 0, "Lost", "Won"),
    banner_yn = ifelse(banner_yn == 0, "No Banner", "Banner")
  ) |>
  left_join(comp_attempts, by = "prolific_pid") |>
  select(-c(comp_attempts, comp_passed)) |>
  left_join(demographics, by = "prolific_pid")

write_csv(anonymize_pid(data_clean_study1b), "../../data/data_clean_study1b.csv")

```

## Study 2 

###Processing

```{r}
parse_consider_set <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "NA") return(integer(0))

  out <- tryCatch(fromJSON(x), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(out)) {
    return(as.integer(out))
  }
}
```


```{r}
data_clean_study2 <- data_raw |>
  filter(prolific_study_id == "69729c24e0172aecb458fa42") |>
  filter(trial_type != "instructions" & trial_type != "survey-multi-choice") |>
  select(
    prolific_pid, trial_index, trial_type, rt, response, choice, outcome, win_status,
    consider_set_size, consider_set, outcome_rel_to_consider
  ) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(response = lead(response, 2)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(choice) & !is.na(outcome)) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(trial_type != "survey-html-form") |>
  mutate(
    consider_set_parsed = map(consider_set, parse_consider_set),
    is_no_consider_trial = (coalesce(consider_set_size, 0) == 0),
    winner_in_consider = map2_lgl(outcome, consider_set_parsed, ~ .x %in% .y),
    choice_in_consider  = map2_lgl(choice,  consider_set_parsed, ~ .x %in% .y)) |>
  mutate(
    response_parsed = map(response, ~ fromJSON(.x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    regret_chosen = map_dbl(response_parsed, ~ .x$regret_chosen %||% NA_real_),
    regret_notchosen_winner = map_dbl(response_parsed, ~ .x$regret_not_winner %||% NA_real_)) |>
  select(-c(response, response_parsed, trial_index, rt, consider_set, consider_set_parsed, trial_type)) |>
  rename(
    winner_number = outcome,
    chosen_number = choice
  ) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(trial = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  relocate(trial, .after = prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(
    win_status = ifelse(win_status == 0, "Lost", "Won"),
    consider_set_size = factor(coalesce(consider_set_size, 0)),
    outcome_rel_to_consider = as.character(outcome_rel_to_consider)
  ) |>
  left_join(comp_attempts, by = "prolific_pid") |>
  select(-any_of(c("comp_attempts", "comp_passed"))) |>
  left_join(demographics, by = "prolific_pid")

write_csv(anonymize_pid(data_clean_study2), "../../data/data_clean_study2.csv")
```
